Columns.ComputedDefinition: (case when [CertificationResults] IS NULL OR [CertificationResults]=N'' then NULL when [CertificationResults] like N'%[%]%' then TRY_CAST(replace([CertificationResults],N'%',N'') AS [decimal](18,4)) when TRY_CAST([CertificationResults] AS [decimal](18,4))<=(1) then TRY_CAST([CertificationResults] AS [decimal](18,4))*(100) else TRY_CAST([CertificationResults] AS [decimal](18,4)) end)
